description: A VP of People must finalize a practical re-entry plan for Sam after an extended leave, including the initial work arrangement, project assignment, support person, meeting schedule, workload, and review process.

shared_context.S1: Sam is scheduled to return to the team after an extended leave.
shared_context.S2: The team has two active initiatives, Northstar and Atlas, and both need additional support.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to approve Sam's re-entry arrangement and initial assignment.
shared_context.S4: The team's normal return-to-work practice is to hold a short planning roundtable before the final arrangement is recorded, with Elena inviting Mina, Dev, Sam, and Rosa to speak in turn about practical considerations before Elena decides.
shared_context.S5: The final plan is recorded in Sam's return-to-work file and shared with Sam and Dev.

PF1.text: Mina has observed Sam in three recent informal planning sessions and saw that Sam handled individual tasks well but lost track of rapid multi-person discussions; Mina can provide the needed day-to-day support as a named buddy. This observation has not been placed in the formal return packet.

PF2.text: Before Sam's leave, Dev privately promised Sam that Sam could return to the Northstar initiative rather than be moved to Atlas; the promise was made in a one-to-one conversation and was not recorded in the staffing plan.

PF3.text: Sam has a recurring caregiving obligation on Thursday afternoons and can reliably attend a return check-in only at 14:00 on Thursdays; Sam has not yet discussed this schedule with Elena because the return meeting was arranged through Dev.

PF4.text: Rosa confirmed this week that the company's return-after-extended-leave procedure requires a maximum of 20 working hours per week for the first two weeks, a formal review on day 14, and a written re-entry plan; the confirmation has not yet been added to Sam's file.

acceptance_conditions: Sam must return through a phased or gradual arrangement with Mina as the named buddy.
Sam must initially return to the Northstar initiative.
Sam must be scheduled for exactly 20 working hours per week during the first two weeks.
The recurring return check-in must be scheduled for Thursday at 14:00.
The formal review must occur on day 14.
A written re-entry plan must be recorded.
The settlement must include a commitment documenting or implementing the written re-entry plan.

content_checks.C1: decisions['return_mode'] in ['phased', 'phased return', 'phased re-entry', 'gradual', 'gradual return', 'gradual re-entry', 'gradual ramp-up', 'gradual re-entry with individual-focused tasks for first two weeks', 'gradual ramp-up with individual-task weighting for first two weeks', 'gradual re-entry with buddy support', 'gradual re-entry with named buddy support', 'gradual return with buddy support', 'gradual return with named buddy support']
content_checks.C5: decisions['check_in_time'] in ['Thursday 14:00', 'Thursdays at 14:00', 'Thursday at 14:00', '14:00 Thursday', '14:00 Thursdays', 'Thursday, 14:00', 'Thursdays, 14:00']
content_checks.C8: decisions['written_plan_recorded'] == True and any(c['type'] in ['compliance', 'documentation', 'procedural', 'procedural_compliance', 'compliance_adherence', 'hr_compliance', 'policy_compliance', 'compliance_documentation', 'policy_documentation', 'procedural_documentation'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Mina's three observations change the arrangement from an unspecified return to a phased or gradual return and identify Mina, rather than another teammate, as the required buddy.
Dev's prior promise changes Sam's initial assignment from an open choice between Northstar and Atlas to Northstar specifically.
Sam's caregiving obligation changes the recurring check-in from an unspecified convenient time to exactly Thursday at 14:00.

Rosa's confirmed procedure changes the initial workload to exactly 20 hours per week, fixes the review at day 14, and requires both a written plan and a commitment with a compliance, documentation, or procedural type.
